name: 資料の形式と画像品質の書き出し設定
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
One actual Lighthouse LH15-0018: file format and image-quality export settings. No full page/device.
Image1 ORIGINAL primary for control anatomy, proportions, optical weight, alignment/spacing: filename/rename; two-segment filetype with FIRST segment selected; quality slider at MAX/rightmost with circular knob centered ON track; centered high-quality description. Use only source x47 y347 w1084 h560. Image2 OUR MOCK secondary Japanese copy and locked typography, correct its undifferentiated mint segments and knob above track using original geometry. Image3 approved bus primary gradient/white-material style only.
Exact UI text:
"配布用資料.pdf" (top-left)
"名前を変更" (top-right)
"ファイル形式"
selected segment "文書"; unselected "画像"
"画像の品質"
"高品質・ファイルサイズ大"
No new labels/number. Meiryo Bold12/16px filename; Regular12/16px every other label/action/segment, tracking0. No giant titles or all-bold controls.
Logical width390px with16px padding, compact settings group. Format label left, two-segment control right with rounded12px container; selected first segment distinct. Quality label next; horizontal fine slider beneath, knob exactly on right end; quality description centered below. Keep actual MAX state, no invented tick labels or numeric value. No icons exist within source region; add none.
Pure#FFFFFF canvas/surface, subtle neutral outline and restrained soft shadow, one rounded white group; no broad mint or nested cards. Ink#1D1D1D, supporting#6E6E6E. Rename original blue action→forestgreen#1F6444. First selected segment may use restrained forest-green gradient#174C36→#1F6444→#2D8F5E with legible white文書; unselected segment white neutral border/gray画像. Active slider track/knob consistentforestgreen; inactive controls neutral. Source selection/max-quality states justify this brand accent, no decorative colors, neon or gloss.
Original fine control geometry overrides rough mock. No source folder picker/search/upload button/header, added CTA/icon/filetype option/value, English, watermark, ID or annotations. Static design candidate, no actual export.
reviewNotes: Opened original and mock. Original segment/slider geometry prioritized: first document segment selected and knob atMAX centered ontrack. Generated output inspected: all Japanese file/rename/format/quality labels retained, no invented values/options/icons. Source blue Rename and meaningful active controls adaptedforestgreen, white neutral unselectedsurface/no mint. Exact font/control pixel metrics unproved; no actual export/owner/native/runtime acceptance.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
